title: Kanna release policy
description: Tunable safety policy for the kd desktop release lifecycle. Read by `kd release status` and `kd release promote` from the repository root. A missing file means the documented defaults apply; an unparseable or unknown key is an error, never a silent fallback.

productionSoakHours.description: Hours a staging release candidate must have been published before `kd release promote` will ship it to production. Measured from the prerelease's GitHub publication time. 0 disables the gate. A promotion may exceed the gate only through the explicit `--override-soak <reason>` human override, which waives this window and nothing else.

linux.description: Linux's release requirements. Linux ships on its own channel pair (desktop-linux-staging / desktop-linux) with its own soak, so a Linux build failure never freezes a macOS ship.

requiredArchitectures.description: Architectures that must all build, pass their dependency audit and pass installed acceptance, at the same version and source revision, before a Linux publish or promotion. A missing required artifact fails the publish; it is never silently omitted, and never satisfied by an older build of the same architecture.

optionalArchitectures.description: Built and published when available, never a gate. Must be disjoint from requiredArchitectures: an architecture that was both would give the publish check and the status report two different answers about the same build.

productionSoakHours.description: Hours a Linux staging candidate must have been published before `kd release promote --platform linux` will ship it. Separate from the top-level value so a change to one platform's window cannot silently retime the other's.
